You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"My Spotify on the webplayer won't load any playlists or my songs. I keep refreshing and logging out/ closing browser and it's not helping."

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! That sounds frustrating. Could you try using an incognito window to see if that helps? Keep us posted!"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Suggest clearing cache/cookies and checking browser compatibility for better troubleshooting."}
